items.summary: LaCroix's questionnaire lists adding classes back to the schedule among her top three issues; her statement lists ensuring the courses students need are offered.
items.title: Add classes back to the schedule

citations.quote: Secondly, adding classes back to the schedule.
Re-establish trust in the college by ensuring the courses students need are offered
citations.locator: Voter Information Pamphlet, Candidate Statements, Community College Board, printed p. 33 (PDF p. 35)

items.summary: LaCroix's questionnaire says she would advocate against cuts and push to reopen the Downtown campus.
items.title: Push to reopen the Downtown campus

citations.quote: Whether it be fiercely advocating against cuts or pushing to reopen the downtown campus, I will be on the front-line demanding answers.

items.summary: The Guardsman reported that LaCroix will work to keep Free City funded, work with SFUSD on college readiness and advocate for free transit passes for students.
items.title: Advocate for free transit passes for students

citations.quote: She will ensure the Free City College program stays funded, seek to work with the San Francisco Unified School District to get students college-ready and advocate for free transit passes for students.

items.summary: The Guardsman reported that LaCroix plans to consult student leaders and the AFT 2121 and SEIU 1021 unions on big decisions.
items.title: Consult student leaders and unions on major decisions

citations.quote: As trustee, she plans to consult student leaders and both faculty and staff unions, AFT 2121 and SEIU 1021, on big decisions.
